description: 1. Description of the offer This custom visual for Power BI transforms your hierarchical data into a beautiful and feature-rich organization chart. It allows you to visualize reporting structures, team compositions, and employee details in an intuitive and interactive format. Key features include: Interactive Navigation: Smoothly zoom and pan through the chart. Expand and collapse branches of the organization with a single click to focus on what matters. Powerful Search: Instantly find any employee by name or ID using the built-in search functionality, which automatically zooms to the selected person. Rich Data Display: Each employee card can display a name, title, division, and profile picture. You can also add custom details (like location or start date) and key performance metrics as badges. Extensive Customization: Tailor the look and feel to match your brand. Customize card colors, fonts, sizes, borders, link styles, and switch between vertical and horizontal layouts. Advanced Tooltips: Hover over any employee to see additional data fields in a detailed tooltip without cluttering the main view. Modern UI: A clean, modern interface with a convenient toolbar provides easy access to all controls, ensuring a great user experience. 2.
